question.text: A wheel of radius $\mathrm{R}$ rolls on the ground with a uniform velocity $\mathrm{v}$. The relative acceleration of topmost point of the wheel with respect to the bottom most point is

solution.text: As $a_{\mathrm{CM}}=0 \quad\left[\mathrm{v}_{\mathrm{CM}}=\right.$ constant $]$, Tangential acceleration of each point $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{a}}_{\mathrm{AB}}\right|=\frac{2 \mathrm{v}^{2}}{\mathrm{R}}$
